text: The Lord, who lives forever, created all things,
and he alone is always faithful. He is the only true God;
one signal from his hand and the universe obeys. The Lord, its mighty King, decides what we are allowed to use, and what he will keep for himself alone.[34]
We cannot understand or tell other people what God's power has done,
because we cannot measure it or count the times he has shown us mercy.
Nor can we make that number larger or smaller. We just stand in amazement at the things he has done,
and at the end of a lifetime of studying them, we are still confused.
As for us humans, what are we? Do we have any purpose? What is good for us and what is bad?
Few of us live a hundred years,
which is a very short time when compared to forever, like a drop of ocean water or a grain of sand along a beach.
That's why the Lord patiently shows us mercy, time after time.
He is eager to forgive, because he knows that we are condemned to die.
We show mercy to our friends, but the Lord has mercy on everyone. He corrects and disciplines and teaches us, and leads us back to him like a shepherd leading a flock of sheep.
If we pay attention when he corrects us, and if we study his laws, he will be merciful.
Students, be careful not to ruin a gift by criticizing the person you give it to.
Like a refreshing dew in the heat of summer, saying the right thing can mean more than giving
even a generous gift. But a truly gracious person will be ready with both.
So don't be a fool. People's eyes will sparkle, if your generosity is sincere and you speak with kindness.
Know what you're talking about before you start speaking and look after your health before it fails.
If you turn from sin now— before you are judged— you will find forgiveness.
Be humble and show that you have turned from sin, and you won't be punished with illness.
If you promise the Lord a gift, give it now. Don't wait until you are dying to keep your promise,
and don't make promises to him unless you are ready to keep them. Don't test the Lord's patience.
When your time comes to die and face him as judge, if he is angry, he will refuse to even look at you.
If you have grown wealthy and have plenty of food, remember when you yourself were poor and hungry.
Between sunrise and sunset is plenty of time for the Lord to turn everything around.
The wise are always careful, and they make sure to do right when others are sinning.
Smart people recognize Wisdom, and they praise everyone who finds her.
If you study the writings of the wise, you will learn enough Wisdom to share with others.
[35]Control your desires; don't let them control you.
If you allow yourself to enjoy everything you want, you will look like a fool, and your enemies will laugh.
Do not live in luxury that you cannot afford, or you will become poor.
If you have nothing, don't borrow money to give a banquet.
